cases.name: first run seeds one version per grade and removes nothing
a changed mark appends a version
a mark changed back appends a third version
a weight change appends a version
a title or date change appends a version
a grade missing from a trusted read is marked removed
a grade missing from an untrusted read is not removed
an empty trusted read removes nothing
a removed grade that comes back is restored without a new version
a removed grade that comes back changed gets a version
a new row id with the same content is the same grade
the same grade under a new course label is the same grade
a row waiting for its mark makes no track or version
the mark arriving on a waiting row makes the first version
a parser upgrade (previous equals next) makes no versions and no removals
two equal grades are tracked apart and one can go
a track keeps its first and its newest 29 versions
the oldest removed tracks are dropped beyond 3000
